payload.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"PYTHONPATH=/reference python3 - <<'PY' | tee /audit-output/evidence/stage4-bijection-and-target.json
import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
from tools.klean_export import expected_target_definition, target_statement, tree_digest, sha256_text
root = Path('/reference/klean-generation')
generated = root/'generated'
ai = json.loads(Path('/audit-input.json').read_text())
ld = json.loads(Path('/reference/lemma-discovery.json').read_text())
im = json.loads((root/'input-manifest.json').read_text())
gm = json.loads((root/'generator-manifest.json').read_text())
er = json.loads((root/'export-result.json').read_text())
om_path = generated/'obligation-map.json'
om = json.loads(om_path.read_text())
independent_domain_ids = []  # established entry-by-entry in stage3-reclassification.md
manifest_domain_ids = [r['source_rule_id'] for r in ld['rules'] if r['classification'] == 'DOMAIN_LEMMA']
recorded_source_id_lists = {
 'independent_reclassification': independent_domain_ids,
 'stage3_manifest': manifest_domain_ids,
 'input_manifest': [r['source_rule_id'] for r in im['source_rules']],
 'obligation_map_source_rules': [r['source_rule_id'] for r in om['source_rules']],
 'obligations': [r['source_rule_id'] for r in om['obligations']],
}
lean_text = '\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in sorted(generated.rglob('*.lean')))
result = {
 'recorded_source_id_lists': recorded_source_id_lists,
 'all_source_id_lists_identical': len({tuple(x) for x in recorded_source_id_lists.values()}) == 1,
 'all_source_id_lists_unique': all(len(x) == len(set(x)) for x in recorded_source_id_lists.values()),
 'domain_set_genuinely_empty': independent_domain_ids == [],
 'obligation_count_actual': len(om['obligations']),
 'obligation_count_generator_manifest': gm['obligation_count'],
 'obligation_count_export_result': er['obligation_count'],
 'obligation_map_sha256_recomputed': hashlib.sha256(om_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'obligation_map_sha256_generator_manifest': gm['obligation_map_sha256'],
 'expected_target_definition': expected_target_definition(om),
 'target_statement_recomputed': target_statement(generated),
 'target_generator_manifest': gm['target'],
 'target_audit_input': ai['resolution']['target'],
 'target_stage4_preflight_audit_input': ai['resolution']['stage4_preflight']['target'],
 'target_declaration_text_matches': re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*(?:def|theorem)\s+generatedTarget\b.*$', lean_text),
 'generated_tree_sha256_recomputed': tree_digest(generated),
 'generated_tree_sha256_generator_manifest': gm['generated_tree_sha256'],
 'generated_tree_sha256_audit_input': ai['resolution']['hashes']['generated_tree_sha256'],
 'selected_status': ai['resolution']['selections']['klean_generation']['status'],
 'export_status': er['status'],
 'preflight_status': ai['resolution']['stage4_preflight']['status'],
 'candidate_present': Path('/candidate').exists(),
 'trust_parameters': om['trust_parameters'],
}
result['zero_obligation_identity_pass'] = (
 result['all_source_id_lists_identical'] and result['all_source_id_lists_unique'] and result['domain_set_genuinely_empty']
 and result['obligation_count_actual'] == result['obligation_count_generator_manifest'] == result['obligation_count_export_result'] == 0
 and result['obligation_map_sha256_recomputed'] == result['obligation_map_sha256_generator_manifest']
 and result['expected_target_definition'] is None and result['target_statement_recomputed'] is None
 and result['target_generator_manifest'] is None and result['target_audit_input'] is None and result['target_stage4_preflight_audit_input'] is None
 and result['target_declaration_text_matches'] == [] and not result['candidate_present'] and result['trust_parameters'] == []
 and result['generated_tree_sha256_recomputed'] == result['generated_tree_sha256_generator_manifest'] == result['generated_tree_sha256_audit_input']
 and result['selected_status'] == result['export_status'] == result['preflight_status'] == 'KLEAN_NO_OBLIGATIONS'
)
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
PY","workdir":"/audit-output","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000});

+import json
